artifact_delivered: Policy gradient methods — REINFORCE, REINFORCE+Baseline, Actor-Critic on MountainCar
workstream_summary: C530: Built policy gradient methods applying C527 theory (policy gradient theorem, advantage functions, actor-critic) to MountainCar. Compared three variants: REINFORCE (MC, high variance, collapsed), REINFORCE+Baseline (variance 0.2, converged to -12.4), Actor-Critic (TD advantage, converged to -12.7). Demonstrated variance-reduction hierarchy: baseline reduces MC variance, TD error reduces further with online updates. Bridges RL theory to practical agent that learns stochastic policies in continuous state.
